intent.problem: Monitor a live CCTV stream without sending its native frame rate to the model.

intent.target_users: Video operators, security reviewers, safety operations teams, and site-access coordinators.

capabilities: Try the included demo or connect one approved RTSP/RTMP camera stream.
Keeps camera credentials out of logs and public reports.
Reports sampled monitoring-goal events with frame times and evidence you can review.
Leaves safety, security, access, and disciplinary decisions to you.
Accepts monitoring goals and answers video questions through Chat.

product.agent_role: Co-worker for reviewing live camera activity and preparing alerts.
product.benefit: Focus your attention on the events you want to watch for, with times and frames you can review.
product.customizable_for: Video monitoring, configurable visual detection, facility operations, and site safety workflows.
product.how_it_works: Independent RF-DETR person sampling plus periodic scene audits feed bounded Cosmos sequences. Facility rules and forecasts bind selected frames; reports retain unexamined rules, human review actions and stage measurements.
product.input: The included demo stream or one approved RTSP/RTMP camera stream, plus what to watch for and your alert settings.
product.output: Live video preview, confirmed goal-event alerts with evidence frames, and requested video answers.

overview: Factory or hotel camera review with frame-linked observations, qualified forecasts and an operator review queue. One camera per Job; requires NVIDIA CUDA. No autonomous safety decision or guaranteed detection.
